## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes, and I added a test if I changed the database or game logic
- [ ] If I added or renamed a command, the README command list is updated
- [ ] If someone else wrote the code I changed, I asked them first (or this is a remux for them to review)
- [ ] If AI helped write this, it's labeled (co-author trailer and a line below)
